en: All talk, these guys!
Whoa! It's huge... But I'll take it down!
Phew... Made it somehow... That should do it.
I wish you'd just go home quietly... If you attack, I'll have to take you down.
Attacking people on the highway... I'll beat you so nobody else gets hurt!
Phew... Now everyone can travel safely.
If you're running wild in Legrance, I can't let it go.{wait}{clear}If you mean to keep attacking villages, I'll take you down!
Yes! The village is safe now!
So it was undead after all. These guys sure are creepy... I'll clean 'em up fast!
Is it over...? Haah... They really are creepy... those things...
What's with you guys... Creepy...
Haah... What a creepy bunch...
Are you the ones tormenting the villagers?!
No matter how many of you gang up on me, I won't lose.
You're... a demon... but why...
Even demons... Damn it!
What are you all plotting, gathered here?
Damn! To think there are people like this...
This village is on an important highway. I'll get rid of any monster running wild here!
Stop running wild in the village!
The village should be safe now. But somehow...
Whoa! What are these things?!
Phew... It's over...
Hehehe... Still a child, but oh well. You'll make a nice ornament.
It's over...
If you won't leave, I'll just have to beat you.
It's over...
So these were behind the whirlwinds?
The village should be fine now.
If only you'd stayed quietly in the forest. If you're coming for me, here I come too.
Phew... That should do it for now.
Are you the bandits running wild around here?
It's because of people like this...!
So it was the undead's doing after all...
I just can't stand this type...
So you're the ones who did it to the villagers!
It's all right now...
Whoa! What's that? Don't tell me these things took the children...?!
Now no more children will be attacked.
I'll beat you before anyone gets hurt.
It's over. Well, that's that.
If you're running this wild, I can't let it go.{wait}{clear}If you mean to keep attacking villages, I'll take you down!
Why did you attack the village and its people?
The village is safe now...
If they can't catch fish, everyone suffers. If you won't go home quietly, I'll fight you!
So the voice was a sea dragon. If it attacks, I'll have to fight...
The townspeople can rest easy now.
Is that all you've got to say to me...? Here I come!
What a nasty bunch...
What... what on earth are you?!
Nesting on the highway is the worst... And this is an important highway.{wait}{clear}If you're in the way, I'll have to beat you.
Humans who team up with monsters out of greed... in my own country too... Damn it!!
If you're after the villagers' lives, I'll take you down!
What a nasty bunch!
So it was you?! You're the ones who took the women!
What a... nasty affair...
I won't let you do that!
Demons showing up even in this forest...
The black shadow was a Shadow?!
I won't let you do as you please any longer!
What...!
Damn those Imperials!{wait}{clear}What?! More of them?!
Alberic? I don't care about him!{wait}{clear}If you drag innocent people into this, you're all my enemies!
So they've reached Alkmaar in Basel...{wait}{clear}Is a march on Legrance just a matter of time?!
Vampire King Ravenruft! I've come to defeat you!
I'll grant you your courage, boy.{wait}{clear}But let me teach you that such courage is mere recklessness.{wait}{clear}Now die!
Why even such a little child... Was he being used by someone too...?
Ngh... What brute strength...
So what ＄＄＄＄＄＄ said was true... But why are these things in the Imperial Army...?
What on earth is going on?
What?! You're the one going down! Get ready!
I won't lose to you demons.
What?! Out of nowhere!{wait}{clear}That's none of your business.
What was with them...?{wait}{clear}Ah, the castle's gone!{wait}{clear}So I can't go any further...?
What a nasty guy... vampires...
You were a hero, weren't you? Why would you become a vampire...?
Can't you even understand words anymore?
This is...{wait}{clear}It's just... too much to bear...
Damn... There's no end to them...
It's no good... not on my own...
What are you doing?! Stop this stupidity!
What a rotten bunch...
Damn! If lots of guys like this show up, what'll happen to this world?!
I'll beat you guys in no time!
No way I'd lose to a demon like that!!
Are you the ones attacking the village?
If you're coming, it can't be helped...
Well then... It's over, so let's head home.
What's the Imperial Army thinking? Attacking a forest like this is pointless, isn't it?
What is about to happen...?
I'd rather be spared that sort of thing.
What's the Imperial Army thinking?
What on earth is about to happen?
What is the Empire thinking...!
Who are you?! We won't let you interfere!!
How long will this go on...?
A man who embodies the Empire's sickness.
Hmph, sickness...{wait}{clear}This sword has healed all of that for me...{wait}{clear}By drinking people's souls!
Healing by evil... Don't make me laugh...
Damn! There's no end to them!
You think you can beat us?!!
As if I'd lose to a bunch of thugs strutting around a little village.
Hmph... All talk, this lot...
Geez... What a worthless bunch...
Let me return the dead to the earth...
Spare me the undead...
No point telling you my name. Here I come!
Too easy...
Even if she's a woman, I can't handle this type...
They say women are monsters, but spare me the real thing.
With so many of that sort around, the trouble never ends.
What? Monsters in the Imperial Army?!
Is this the Demon Stone's doing too...?
If only you'd behaved yourselves.
If words won't get through to you, it can't be helped...
What good does attacking a little village do...?
A monster in armor...{wait}{clear}Fine, I'll be your opponent.
So long, Rocus.{wait}{clear}...Don't worry, I'll be along later too.
What's the point of attacking a backwater like this?
What a nasty lot...
What on earth will become of this world...?
What good does attacking a little Ecclesia village like this do?!
As if I'd ever bow to you...
Ecclesia too, at last... But it won't end here... I'm sure of it...
Attacking a little Ecclesia village, and women too? How cowardly!
Doing this... what good will it do?!
Damn! At this rate there's no end to it!
Even monsters like this in the Imperial Army? It's just like that legend...
...I can't believe it's really come to this... But I won't give up...
What's this? This stench of blood... Geez, I should never have come here.
...I'm never taking a job like this again.
I've no wish to look at ugly flowers... Let's get rid of it quickly...
Heh... It's over...
Only going after women, you cowards. If you've hurt any women, I won't forgive you!
Hmph! The likes of you could never match me.
Being attacked by something like this would be no joke...
Phew... The ships should be safe now...
Phew... I didn't want to come to the shore to fight, but it can't be helped...{wait}{clear}You won't go home quietly, will you? Then I'll just have to defeat you.
Phew... That should do it...
Running wild on the highway is a nuisance. I'll get rid of you quickly.
It's over... Now the highway can be used again.
You won't go home quietly, will you? Then I'll just have to defeat you.
Phew... Is it over...?
It's over... That should do it.
Undead, as I thought... Ugh... Having to deal with this lot... Oh well, I'll clean them up quickly!
You lot should stay quietly in the ground.
A banshee, as I thought... Knowing what it is doesn't make it any less creepy...
Phew... It's over... But I can't stand this sort of thing.
Are you the ones attacking Ecclesia's villages?
What a worthless bunch... Geez...
You... a demon...
What are you planning?
Legrance seems to have it rough too... Well, it's nothing to do with me...
Running wild on the highway is a nuisance. Let's get rid of you quickly...
Would you mind not running wild in the village?
The village is fine now, but... it doesn't feel very good...
Whoa! What a nasty feeling... this is...
